title: Annie Dillard
idiom: woodcut or lithograph — dense cross-hatched American pastoral ink, evoking mid-century naturalist illustration
hero_prompt: A wide darkened-backdrop woodcut illustration: a solitary desk sits at the edge of a dense Virginia woodland, a single oil lamp casting amber light onto open notebooks. Crow feathers, creek stones, and pressed leaves ring the desk. The woods press in close, all ink crosshatching and deep shadows. No human figure — the desk and the forest are the subject. Medium: woodcut print, black ink on aged cream paper, bold grain marks. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: A bold square emblem in woodcut style: a single open eye at centre, iris replaced by a dense forest canopy seen from below, in black ink on cream ground. Thick outlines, no fine linework, high contrast, legible at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
